notes.title: Now available on Steam: Persnippety
notes.content:
Persnippety is now available on Steam with a 10% launch discount!*

Never lose a clipboard snippet again with Persnippety.

[list]
[*] Flexible - Persnippety can keep track of your clipboard's text or images.
[*] Accessible - use a single keystroke to record important content into Persnippety, or automatically save every clipboard item you copy for safe-keeping.
[*] Easy - your snippets are stored in an easy-to-use interface that can be pulled up with a preferred keyboard shortcut.
[*] Customizable - specify your preferred interface style, and which keyboard shortcuts you want to use with Persnippety.
[/list]

* Offer ends June 26, 10am Pacific
